plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 5th house brings heat into romance, sex, creativity, and play. The pursuit can feel exciting and energizing. Keep competition playful, because this overlay can turn flirtation into provocation when nobody slows down.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
